scope: Current engine danger entry retention across bounded group-intake batching
sourceIntent: LAMBS brain evaluates the queued danger causes and selects a priority response. CBE retains its bounded linear selection and single shared group owner; this fixes a CBE intake loss rather than copying an upstream script or claiming whole LAMBS parity.
finding: Start_Danger explicitly prepends the current entry. Init selected only the last11 records plus the strongest. With a longer queue and a different stronger record, the current event could be absent when the queue was cleared. The counterexample follows directly from CBE array operations and does not assume native engine queue ordering.
changes: Snapshot original current entry cause, copied position, expiry and source into one FSM-local record.
Group intake uses the prior bounded queue tail10 plus unique current entry and strongest selection, at most12 records. Strongest priority selection/window48 remain unchanged.

Clear the entry snapshot after the first submission, so recycle passes do not replay it. Preserve current eligibility, knowledge, ignoreTarget and finite-expiry filters; data retention is not a tactical action or guaranteed response.
Editable danger.bifsm and runtime danger.fsm contain matching changed state code. No additional actor command, observation query, worker, sorting pass or group-wake path.

validation.failureDisposition: Existing editable/runtime FSM parity caught the graph not yet updated. Synced both changed states; parity assertion preserved.
validation.result: PASS including HEMTT/FSM/config/SQF/documentation/package gates. Existing regression models old lost-entry counterexample, distinct/duplicate retention and <=12 capacity across0..48 sizes. No new test cases.
validation.provenance: Unsigned281cf53c plus intended FSM/editor/doc edits and retained unrelated working-tree dirt. Later engineering metadata not product source. Not a clean signed release.
validation.limits: Python array model/source/graph checks do not execute the native engine FSM or prove real danger delivery, group reaction, HC operation or performance. Audits paused.

cost: Same evaluated48-record window and12-record submit cap. One copied entry, two bounded unique insertions, no additional world query or tactical scheduler. Raw native queue append ordering is not inferred. Runtime cost unmeasured.
remaining: Other nonselected/nonentry causes can still fall outside bounded tail; this does not guarantee all native events reach group planning.
Physical immediate danger/confirmed contact coexistence, event interruption, repeat/locality and5%median/10%p95 runtime evidence remain unverified.
Mounted-command assumptions in mounted-command-semantics-20261022.json stay open; no speculative driver rewrite. Full production goal incomplete.
sourceProtection: LAMBS private reference unchanged; no upstream raw code/assets added to product.
